scene.background: modern, well-lit gym studio with large windows in the background allowing ample natural light to flood the space, creating soft highlights on their skin and casting subtle shadows beneath them. The background includes gym equipment: a rack of dumbbells to the right, a resistance band looped over a bar, and the curved metal frame of a treadmill or elliptical machine to the left. The floor is dark, polished concrete, reflecting the subjects and equipment faintly, adding depth and realism.
scene.lighting: bright and even, with a slightly cool white balance that enhances the clarity of the scene, and the color saturation is moderately high — the teal mats, the pink sports bra, and the black gear stand out vividly against the neutral gray walls and floor.
scene.camera_angle: low, eye-level shot, slightly to the side of the subjects, capturing them from a three-quarter perspective that emphasizes their form and posture.
scene.style: Professional fitness photography — clean, high-contrast, studio-lit, with a modern gym aesthetic.
scene.mood: disciplined, energetic, and focused — evoking the dedication of a fitness routine.
scene.color_palette: teal, pink, black, gray, white, and light blue

attributes.pose: plank position: hands planted firmly on the mat, elbows bent at 90 degrees, core engaged, and body aligned in a straight line from head to heels. Their forearms are flat on the mat, and their hands are slightly clenched into fists.
